nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set in constructor from msg.sender
Owned.newOwner: address pending ownership acceptance, written by transferOwnership
FixedSupplyToken.symbol token ticker string
FixedSupplyToken.name token display name
FixedSupplyToken.decimals uint8 precision, set to 18
_totalSupply fixed token supply assigned to owner in constructor
balances mapping(address => uint) holding token balances
allowed nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function that stages newOwner
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then transfers ownership
totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address) view returning balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address,uint): moves tokens from msg.sender using SafeMath sub/add
approve(address,uint): writes allowance for msg.sender without double-spend check
transferFrom(address,address,uint): spends allowance and moves balances with SafeMath
allowance(address,address) view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval
payable fallback function that always reverts
transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint): onlyOwner sweep of a foreign ERC20 via external call
SafeMath.add(uint,uint) internal pure returning a+b with overflow require
SafeMath.sub(uint,uint) internal pure returning a-b with underflow require
SafeMath.mul(uint,uint) internal pure returning a*b with overflow require
SafeMath.div(uint,uint) internal pure returning a/b with divide-by-zero require
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and balance keys
require(c >= a) overflow guard inside SafeMath.add
require(b <= a) underflow guard inside SafeMath.sub
require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard inside SafeMath.mul
owner = newOwner ownership state transition write in acceptOwnership
external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) with user data
external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to arbitrary address
balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens) balance subtraction state write in transfer
allowed[from][msg.sender].sub(tokens) allowance subtraction state write in transferFrom
revert() executed in the payable fallback to reject ETH
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control check in onlyOwner modifier
to: destination address parameter of transfer
tokens: amount parameter of transfer
spender: address parameter of approve and approveAndCall
from: source address parameter of transferFrom
tokenOwner: address parameter of balanceOf and allowance
data: calldata bytes parameter forwarded to receiveApproval
tokenAddress: foreign token contract address parameter of transferAnyERC20Token
_newOwner: pending owner address parameter of transferOwnership
a: first operand of SafeMath.add
b: second operand of SafeMath.add
c: local result variable returned by SafeMath.add
balance: named local return variable of balanceOf

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner inside the onlyOwner require
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership based on msg.sender
acceptOwnership is gated by require(msg.sender == newOwner)
owner state variable initialized from msg.sender in the Owned constructor
msg.sender used as balances mapping key in transfer
msg.sender used as allowed outer key in approve
msg.sender used in allowance lookup and decrement in transferFrom
msg.sender used for allowance write and forwarded to receiveApproval
transfer performs balances subtraction on msg.sender balance
transfer adds recipient balance through SafeMath add
transferFrom decrements allowance via SafeMath sub
transferFrom decrements sender balance via SafeMath sub
external call into spender-controlled contract after allowance state write
external call to an arbitrary caller-supplied token contract with no reentrancy guard
acceptOwnership writes owner = newOwner without reentrancy protection
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable
SafeMath.add enforces the overflow guard require(c >= a)
SafeMath.sub enforces the underflow guard require(b <= a)
SafeMath.mul enforces the overflow guard require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
fallback function unconditionally executes revert()
transfer destination address to is supplied by the caller
transfer amount tokens is supplied by the caller
approve spender address is supplied by the caller
transferFrom source address from is supplied by the caller
balanceOf tokenOwner address is supplied by the caller
approveAndCall bytes data is forwarded into the external callback
transferAnyERC20Token tokenAddress drives the external transfer target
transferOwnership _newOwner is written into newOwner
parameter a is the first operand of SafeMath.add
parameter b is the second operand of SafeMath.add
local c holds and returns the result of SafeMath.add
local balance holds and returns balances[tokenOwner] in balanceOf

normalization_plan.reason: to is only meaningful as the transfer destination argument of transfer
tokens only parameterizes the balance subtraction arithmetic in transfer
spender is only used as the allowance key of approve and approveAndCall
from is only meaningful as the debited account inside transferFrom
tokenOwner is only used as the lookup key of balanceOf/allowance views
data is only forwarded into the external receiveApproval callback
tokenAddress selects the external contract target of the ERC20 transfer call
_newOwner is only used to assign the newOwner state variable
a is only a transient operand of the SafeMath.add helper
b is only a transient operand of the SafeMath.add helper
c is the transient return local of SafeMath.add
balance is the transient named return local of balanceOf
